reason: The sole cited evidence (E1) concerns CoCrFeNiTix HEA coatings on Q235, not the natural passive film on bare Q235 steel. It provides no support for any of the key premises about native oxide formation, defect-driven film non-uniformity, chloride penetration, or temperature effects on the uncoated substrate.
premises: Q235 steel naturally forms a passive iron oxide film
Microstructural defects cause non-uniformity in this passive film
Chloride ions penetrate oxide films and promote pitting at weak spots
Elevated temperature accelerates passive film breakdown and corrosion
Defect density directly controls the onset and severity of pitting corrosion
